mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing haloperidol metabolism and increasing haloperidol plasma concentrations, while both drugs carry independent CNS and hepatotoxic risks.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation); consider haloperidol dose reduction; monitor liver function tests as both drugs are hepatotoxic.
